features.title: How does it work?
features.subtitle: Three simple steps to go from video tutorial to written pattern.
features.step1Desc: Copy a YouTube tutorial URL and paste it into the tool.
features.step2Desc: Our AI analyzes the transcript and generates a structured pattern.
features.step3Desc: The pattern appears with timestamps, ready to follow while watching the video.

why.title: Why Hookara?
why.timeDesc: No more manually noting each step while watching the video.
why.terminologyDesc: Choose between French or American terminology.
why.timestampsDesc: Each step is linked to the exact moment in the video.
why.publicDesc: Subtitles are public — Hookara just formats them to save you time.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: What's the difference between FR and US terminology?
faq.a1: Crochet stitches have different names depending on the country (for example, a US "single crochet" is a French "maille serrée"). You choose the terminology that suits you, and the pattern adapts automatically.
faq.a2: Each step in the pattern is linked to the exact moment in the video where it's explained. A click takes you directly to the right section if you need to review a technique.
faq.q3: How long does pattern generation take?
faq.a3: Generally less than a minute, depending on the video length.
faq.q4: Are my data / the video I submit stored?
faq.a4: No, we don't store any data.
faq.a5: No, only videos with subtitles can provide instructions.
faq.q6: Does the original video lose views?
faq.a6: No. The video plays through YouTube's official player, so views and watch time are counted for the creator. Hookara just formats the public subtitles to save you time.
